items.description: Disposal of shed debris, tree waste and root ball
items.rationale: The storm-felled tree struck the insured shed (§2.5.3(c)), and all four materials qualify under §5.2.1(a)–(b), including the single root ball under 1 m³, so §7.1.10 does not bar the combined line. Estimated gross disposal cost is €65 for timber + €32 for glass + €54 for green waste + €40 for the root ball, excluding any duplicate haulage under §7.1.8(c).

items.description: Disposal of soil, topsoil and paving grit
items.rationale: All three materials are excluded from debris clearance under §5.2.1(d), and stand-alone disposal without reinstatement-related ground works and making good fails §5.2.2. The threshold is therefore zero; €120 is the conditional gross estimate if the line were covered.
